description: Funding rate history for one Hyperliquid perp — how the rate actually behaved over the past days, not just its value right now: average, range, how much of the time it stayed positive, and what holding the position would have paid. Includes the current predicted rate on Binance and Bybit for comparison. Use this when the question is whether a funding spread is durable rather than what it is this hour. Read-only, public data, no API key.

days.description: How far back to look. Default 7, maximum 14.

symbol.description: Perp symbol, e.g. BTC or HYPE.

name: hl_funding
title: Funding history
